title: every class with code in bus_client reaches the diagnostic mixin
intention: Every class with code in cairn/tools/bus_client reaches DiagnosticBase, so RemoteBus and DeviceRoster can produce a diagnostic report when we are stuck and the sieve reads bus_client green.

why.lived: Closing 95c919b5f4aa (the bus_client command mouth), the PROVED gate refused on every_class_reaches_the_diagnostic_mixin for roster.py's DeviceRoster — a class the ticket never touched. Akien 2026-10-27: 'any class with code it in should be able to run a diagnostic report when we need it'.

measured.saw: remote.py:360 class RemoteBus and roster.py:23 class DeviceRoster have code and do not reach DiagnosticBase ('no route'); no other bus_client finding
measured.how: PYTHONPATH=. python3 -c "from cairn.machines.build_inspector import inspector as i; from pathlib import Path; print(i.every_class_reaches_the_diagnostic_mixin({'dir':'tools/bus_client','component':'cairn/tools/bus_client'}, Path('cairn/tools/bus_client').resolve()))"

traces_to: Law 3 (nothing is known until measured); Law 10 (nothing in the system is immeasurable); RULE 1 (the fix lives in bus_client's own files); ticket 339a45cee6a1.
how: Add `from cairn.tools.base.diagnostic import DiagnosticBase` after the stdlib imports in remote.py and roster.py; make it the first (only) base: `class RemoteBus(DiagnosticBase)`, `class DeviceRoster(DiagnosticBase)`; class bodies unchanged (neither __init__ calls super — DiagnosticBase's lazy __dict__ path covers that, as for frozen Workflow under e8b58520aeb9). Red-first proof shaped like aider_shim's.

clauses.claim: RemoteBus and DeviceRoster are DiagnosticBase subclasses and behave as before: RemoteBus keeps _home/_far, verbs keys 'shim' for module:Class else 'device', a far unanswering home raises without starting anything; DeviceRoster.hold is idempotent by device_id and held keeps order; remote.py's top-level imports are stdlib plus cairn.tools.base.diagnostic
every other cairn/tools/bus_client proof stays green

decisions.text: Red-first proof cairn/tools/bus_client/proofs/test_every_bus_client_class_reaches_the_diagnostic_mixin.py, shaped like the aider_shim one: check()/FAILURES/main(), imports at call time.
